containerDefinitions.name: db-bootstrap
command:
set -eu
export PGPASSWORD="$MASTER_PASSWORD"

psql "host=$DB_HOST port=$DB_PORT user=$MASTER_USERNAME dbname=postgres sslmode=require" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
\\getenv np_user NONPROD_USERNAME
\\getenv np_pass NONPROD_PASSWORD
\\getenv np_db NONPROD_DATABASE
\\getenv pr_user PROD_USERNAME
\\getenv pr_pass PROD_PASSWORD
\\getenv pr_db PROD_DATABASE

SELECT format('CREATE ROLE %I LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'np_user', :'np_pass')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'np_user') \\gexec
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I WITH LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'np_user', :'np_pass') \\gexec
SELECT format('CREATE DATABASE %I OWNER %I', :'np_db', :'np_user')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = :'np_db') \\gexec
SELECT format('ALTER DATABASE %I OWNER TO %I', :'np_db', :'np_user') \\gexec

SELECT format('CREATE ROLE %I LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'pr_user', :'pr_pass')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'pr_user') \\gexec
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I WITH LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'pr_user', :'pr_pass') \\gexec
SELECT format('CREATE DATABASE %I OWNER %I', :'pr_db', :'pr_user')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = :'pr_db') \\gexec
SELECT format('ALTER DATABASE %I OWNER TO %I', :'pr_db', :'pr_user') \\gexec
SQL

echo "CarLease database roles and logical databases are provisioned."
